# Peter Maquiran

> Platform and reliability engineer with 9+ years in production systems. Designs and operates architecture, observability, and security controls — the work behind solutions architecture, platform architecture, site reliability, and security. Tagline: Building Systems for Resilience and Performance.

Canonical site: https://peter.tvone.ao. This file is the plain-text version of that single-page portfolio. The homepage collapses application tools behind "Show More"; those tools are included below. Visitors whose browser language is Portuguese receive the same facts in Portuguese. Pages under /admin and /playground are private tools and are not part of this portfolio.

Stack shown on the page:

- Platform: Docker, Linux, Nginx, Gitea, Drone CI, MinIO S3
- Reliability: Prometheus, Zipkin, Loki, Grafana, Grafana Alloy, Uptime Kuma
- Security: Keycloak, Vault, WireGuard, NetBird, Cloudflare
- Applications: NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, React, Vue, Flutter, Tailwind, Socket.io, TUS Upload, Playwright, Firebase

Also used across the work: TypeScript, Angular, Ionic, Capacitor, Node.js, HTML, CSS, Three.js, RxJS, Zod, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, REST, WebSockets, Docker Swarm, Android, and iOS.

## Projects

- [Self-Hosted DevOps Stack](https://grafana.tvone.ao/?orgId=1&from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser): Production platform: Docker Swarm, Nginx with TLS via Certbot, a private registry and Git server, Drone CI, and one pipeline for metrics, logs, and traces. Stack: Docker, Grafana, Drone CI, Gitea.
- [ZenTrace](https://www.npmjs.com/package/zentrace): TypeScript tracing library for production debugging. It records which functions ran, how the async flow moved, and the logs and HTTP calls on each step, in a Chrome DevTools panel. Trace class methods with @trace() and plain functions with traceFn(). Stack: TypeScript, Chrome DevTools, Zipkin, Loki.
- [TVOne News Portal](https://tvone.ao/): News platform on NestJS and Next.js. Redis caches article delivery. RabbitMQ carries publish and notification work off the request path. Stack: NestJS, Next.js, Redis, RabbitMQ.
- [Holistic Life Organizer](https://github.com/PeterMaquiran/orga1): Personal platform with Keycloak for sign-in, a NestJS API, PostgreSQL for state, and a Flutter client for habits, scheduling, and an organic garden planner. Stack: Keycloak, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Flutter.
- [E-Commerce Platform](https://github.com/PeterMaquiran/AWS-Examples): Storefront with secure payments, real-time order processing, and infrastructure aimed at staying available under load. Stack: Nuxt.js, Laravel, MySQL.
- [Reactive Portfolio Website](https://peter.tvone.ao): This site. Next.js in English and Portuguese, with live visitor presence over Socket.io. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Three.js, Socket.io.

## Experience

- [Equilibrium](https://peter.tvone.ao/#experience): Software Engineer, Jun 2020 — Present. Connected production platforms to logs, metrics, and tracing, with a stated 15% increase in system stability. EMIS-compliant payment flows, including automatic direct-debit subscriptions. Modules that generate and validate bank collection files (IDD pacs.003). Internal platform with institutional calendars, K2 workflows, and real-time messaging.
- [Powercon](https://peter.tvone.ao/#experience): Software Engineer, Jan 2019 — Jun 2020. Distributed tracing and observability that cut critical failure resolution time by 40%. Background task processing in the interface. Responsive portals and inventory systems.
- [Clínica Multiperfil](https://peter.tvone.ao/#experience): Backend Developer, Sep 2018 — Dec 2018. Scripts that filled internal hospital documentation.
- [Theus](https://peter.tvone.ao/#experience): Frontend Developer, Jan 2017 — Mar 2018. E-commerce interface, light and dark themes, and a fast-loading page structure.
